# Reports QA fixture

A project root that HAS reports, built for the human QA packet of RUN-CONSOLE-REPORTS-SURFACE-001.
Its `reports/` folder carries the four real cases verbatim, the volume fixture, one report that
does not parse and one run folder with nothing filed in it. Its `.project/` folder is emitted by
the real projector, so what the console reads here is what it reads anywhere.
